equity.level_reason: Age only defines the population and is standardized; occupation groups are framed as occupational exposure categories, not social position, so no SPD comparison.

equity.equity_measurement: Usual occupation from death certificates, collapsed into 22 broad groups; only the highest-rate groups are shown; unpaid and military occupations excluded; CPS denominators.

notes: Design inferred (no design named). The CPS is used only for denominators and is not listed as a data source. Occupation is not treated as SES because it is not framed as social position.
